phenotypicFeatures.description: retrosternal pain accompanied by radiating pain
heart rate at admission was 130 beats per minute
ECG results showed ventricular tachycardia (VT) at 213 b.p.m.
Echocardiography showed thinning and protruding of the LV apex with local contradictory movements
Cardiac magnetic resonance imaging demonstrated abnormal systolic activity at the LV apex
chest pain, palpitations, and profuse sweating
T-wave inversion in leads V1 to V4
paroxysmal ventricular tachycardia, which presented as left bundle branch block (LBBB) morphology
Echocardiography results demonstrated left atrial enlargement
Cardiac magnetic resonance imaging showed LV apical dilatation, loss of systolic activity, and paradoxical motion during systole

type.label: Fatty replacement of ventricular myocardial tissue

phenotypicFeatures.description: Fat-suppressed T1-weighted images (T1WI) showed an increase in fat signal at the LV apex
fat-suppressed T2-weighted images (T2WI) demonstrated a significant increase in adipose signal and LV late gadolinium enhancement at the apex
